jobs.title: Investment Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Maincode Ventures

Frontier AI requires a completely different kind of support. We know this intimately from our experience building Matilda and operating at the edge of the space. That is why we launched Maincode Ventures.

We are backing the next generation of Australian-made frontier AI startups with much more than just a cheque. We have built the launchpad we wish we had, offering visionary founders:

  • Founder salaries from Day 1

  • Non-dilutive capital

  • Unlimited access to Matilda AI products and tokens

  • Comprehensive back-office operations support

We know what it takes to succeed at the frontier. Now we are looking for a mission-oriented operator to help us find and fund the people who will build the future.

The Role

We are looking for a Founding Investment Associate. If you are currently working at an established venture fund and want a faster track to real impact, this is your next step.

You already know the mechanics of venture capital. You know how to source, evaluate, and write an investment memo. But you want more autonomy and a faster progression path than a traditional ten-year partner track can offer. Here, you will not just be screening deals for a massive partnership to vote on. You will build the fund alongside us, shape our investment thesis, and work directly with founders at the bleeding edge of AI.

If you are tired of evaluating incremental B2B SaaS and want to focus purely on frontier technology, this role is for you.

What You Will Do

  • Lead Sourcing: Actively map the Australian AI ecosystem. You will network with researchers and engineers to identify exceptional future founders before they are on the radar of the broader VC market.

  • Drive Diligence: Run deep evaluations on early-stage AI ventures. You will assess the technical viability of their models, the strength of their vision, and their potential to scale.

  • Build the Fund: As a founding member of the team, you will design the internal systems of Maincode Ventures. You will build our deal flow tracking, shape our DD processes, and help deploy our back-office support for portfolio companies.

  • Direct Founder Support: Act as a core operational partner to the startups we back. You will help them manage early growth and remove roadblocks so they can focus entirely on building.

Who You Are

  • Venture Experienced: You have 2 to 3 years of experience in venture capital. You understand how funds operate, but you are looking for a role with higher agency and faster career growth.

  • AI Fluent: You deeply understand the current AI landscape. You know the difference between a thin wrapper and true frontier innovation, and the technical mechanics of AI excite you.

  • High Agency: You thrive in unstructured environments. You take the initiative to build processes where none exist and you do not wait for a senior partner to tell you what to do next.

  • Clear Communicator: You can distil complex technical concepts into sharp investment theses and build rapid rapport with highly technical founders.

Why Join Us?

This is a rare opportunity to step out of a rigid fund hierarchy and get in on the ground floor of a uniquely structured firm. You will be at the absolute forefront of the Australian AI ecosystem, working daily with the smartest minds in the space and accelerating your career by building a fund from day one.

jobs.title: AI Research Resident
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Maincode is an Australian AI research company building Matilda, an assistant that understands complex work, reasons over context, and takes meaningful action safely.

The AI Research Residency is a paid 3 to 6 month program for late-stage PhD students and exceptional early-career researchers who want to pursue high-impact AI research grounded in real systems.

Residents work closely with Maincode's research and engineering teams, with dedicated access to large-scale GPU compute and our in-house research infrastructure. You will explore open problems, run experiments at scale, and produce work that can contribute to top-tier publications, open research, infrastructure, or the systems behind Matilda.

This role is research-first, but applied. Strong projects may take the form of model research, evaluations, infrastructure, technical engineering work, or product-facing research that improves Matilda and future Maincode systems.

Research areas

We are interested in research that makes AI systems more capable, reliable, efficient, and useful in the real world.

The residency program is primarily focused on the following areas:

Agents

  • Tool use, planning, memory, computer control, multi-agent systems, and safe execution in real-world environments.

  • Long-context reasoning, workflow understanding, state tracking, memory systems, and methods for maintaining coherence across complex tasks.

Safety and evaluation

  • Capability evaluations, alignment, oversight, interpretability, robustness, red-teaming, and benchmarks for real-world task completion.

Training and algorithms

  • Language model training, reinforcement learning, reasoning methods, optimisation, architectures, and new approaches to improving model behaviour.

Data

  • Data curation, filtering, synthetic data, mixture design, quality verification, pruning, and principled approaches to training signal.

Multimodal systems

  • Vision-language models, grounding, perception, multimodal reasoning, and systems that combine language, visual context, and action.

Efficiency and infrastructure

  • Training and inference efficiency, kernels, parallelism, sharding, decoding, quantisation, scheduling, and systems for running large models reliably.

Responsibilities

  • Lead research that advances Maincode's work on capable, useful, and trustworthy AI systems.

  • Design and execute experiments, develop new research directions, and collaborate closely with our researchers and engineers.

  • Produce research outputs suitable for top-tier conferences, journals, technical reports, open-source releases, or deployment in Matilda and future Maincode systems.

Qualifications

  • Late-stage PhD student, recent PhD graduate, or exceptional early-career researcher.

  • Strong research taste and the ability to identify important problems before they are obvious.

  • Experience publishing, preprinting, or producing high-quality research in AI, machine learning, or adjacent technical fields.

  • Ability to define and execute independent research under uncertainty.

  • Interest in building AI systems that can reason, act, and operate reliably in complex real-world environments.

What you will have access to

  • Dedicated access to Maincode's GPU compute and research infrastructure.

  • Close collaboration with a small, high-calibre team across AI research, systems engineering, product engineering, and design.

  • Support for top-tier conference and journal submissions, with the opportunity for strong research to contribute to Matilda and future Maincode systems.

  • A research environment focused on deep work, technical seriousness, and real-world impact.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Maincode · Seattle, WA · On-site

Engineers wanted for hard work on real problems. Small team, flat hierarchy, high agency, real work. Full ownership over what you build.

Maincode is building Matilda, Australian-made AI. Most of the team is in Melbourne, but we are building out an office in Seattle.

The work.

Matilda is up and running: app, web, CLI, and desktop - all deployed in production and serving on our own cluster. What we need now is engineering. New features, better products, sharper agents and tooling. These are the layers where value is really engineered. Seattle works the layer above the models. The team is around a dozen people, so nothing here is a ticket queue. You see what matters, you build it, and it is in production that week.

You.

The bar is high. We want exceptional engineers who build because they cannot help it, who move without being told to, and who would rather be handed a problem than a spec. No process theatre, no politics, just engineering.

Benefits.

$110,000 to $175,000 USD. Health, dental and vision covered, 401(k), paid leave. Real work, no bullshit.

Process.

  1. Apply below.

  2. A 20-minute intro call. We learn about you, you learn about Maincode.

  3. Technical assignment + review interview.

  4. Meeting the team + decisions.

Highly selective and intentional at each stage.

US work authorization required.

jobs.title: Commercial Counsel (AI & Technology)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Maincode

Maincode is Australia's #1 AI company and the creator of Matilda, our flagship frontier AI product, and we're growing fast and building at the cutting edge of what's possible. We're looking for a lawyer to join our in-house team and take real ownership of the governance, compliance, and legal work that keeps us moving and building responsibly.

The Role

This is an incredible opportunity for a practitioner early in their career who wants to work at the forefront of AI, with real ownership, real autonomy, and the chance to do actual lawyering from day one. You'll be the day-to-day point of contact for legal matters across Maincode and Matilda, working closely with our team as we scale locally and internationally, and building up a keen knowledge of how AI works at the frontier.

Day to day, you'll handle governance and regulatory compliance across our products, draft and manage our legal terms and customer and partner contracts, work on audits and product-facing legal matters, and provide practical counsel to the team on a wide range of issues, all while working independently and autonomously with limited reliance on external counsel.

What we're looking for

  • A qualified lawyer with 2+ years of general commercial practice experience

  • Must hold an unrestricted Australian practicing certificate

  • An appetite to do real lawyering and grow into a true AI specialist by handling these matters on a regular basis

  • Comfort working independently and autonomously, with little reliance on external counsel

  • A curious, hungry, and scrappy mindset, eager to learn, adapt, and take ownership

  • A self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, growing startup environment

Why Maincode

You'll work at the frontier of AI in Australia, with high ownership, high learning, and a genuine path to becoming a specialist in-house AI counsel as we continue to grow locally and internationally.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Mission

We are building the future of Australian-made AI. We believe it is critical to this country. Our product is Matilda. Maincoders are driven by a singular purpose that goes far beyond just another job. We believe this is our country’s time to shine; requiring a level of selflessness, dedication, and restlessness from everyone involved. For us to succeed in making Australian-made AI world-class, we need people who are tireless, passionate, and completely devoted to the cause. We will always choose someone with spirit, passion, and a true love for what we are building over someone who is highly credentialed but uninspired, because while we can teach skills, we can never teach heart.

What we build

Matilda is a production system, available to use and integrate now. We run inference and model training on our own infrastructure.

 

What We Are Looking For

Graduate software engineers. Across any layer of Maincode. Do your research and tell us how you can help. Previous industry experience is a plus, including internships.

jobs.title: Talent Sourcer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Maincode

Maincode makes Matilda, an Australian-made AI stack we run end-to-end, from tin to token. We operate our own infrastructure here in Australia, train and maintain our own frontier models, and run multiple surfaces on top of them, including chat, coding, and APIs. Everything we ship is built on capability we control ourselves.

We are looking for someone energetic and outgoing to help us find the strongest engineers and researchers in Australia. The people we want to hire are rarely applying to anything. You should love meeting people, be genuinely curious about what they build, and have the judgment to tell who is worth our time.


The Role

You will find engineers and researchers who look good, wherever they actually are: GitHub, papers, meetups, communities, referrals. You will reach out, start real conversations, and meet people in person where you can. You will vet what they have built and who they are, and bring the ones worth talking to directly to our talent lead with a short, honest note on why.

You will be the first Maincode person most of our hires ever speak to. We value autonomy, speed, and high agency. The best way to understand this position is to review our work, understand what we are building, and think about how you would get the right people excited about it.


Qualifications & Expectations

  • Sourcing experience: Some experience sourcing or recruiting for technical roles is a plus.

  • Outreach and presence: You are warm, enthusiastic, and extroverted. You are happy to put yourself out there, meet new people, and wear Maincode on your sleeve.

  • Strong signal: You read people well. You pick up on what someone actually cares about, adjust how you talk to them, and you communicate a direct, unvarnished read on the people you bring forward.



Details

Location: Sydney / Melbourne (Hybrid)

Type: Full-time, permanent

Remuneration: Competitive salary (commensurate with experience) + super

jobs.title: Behavioural Researcher
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Maincode

Maincode is an AI research and engineering company. We build Matilda, Australia's large language model, trained, served and deployed here in Melbourne. We run our own GPUs in local data centres and we build everything above them: the racks, the training and serving systems, and the products that run on them.


About the Role

The hardest problem at Maincode is not the tech. It is finding the small number of people who can build a frontier AI company. You will join the talent team at Maincode and own a piece of that problem.

Your job is to understand people. Personality, motivation, belief, mindset: what someone is actually made of, and whether it is what a team like this needs. You will make reads on real candidates, and you will rebuild the way we make them: the interviews, the instruments, and the agentic systems the pipeline runs on. Nothing about our process is sacred. If a stage does not predict, you kill it and build something that does.

Maincode is built on a small number of obsessive people working on hard problems. We are direct with each other, the bar does not move, and the team is the product, so the calls we make about people are the most important calls we make. You should recognise that way of working and want more of it.

You do not need a background in talent. If anything, we prefer that you do not have one.


What You'll Do

Read candidates: their work, their words, their rooms; produce the judgments the team hires from.

Design and test the instruments: interview formats, screens, rubrics. Treat the pipeline as a running experiment and follow the results.

Build with AI. The pipeline is agentic end to end. You extend it, not just operate it.

Work day to day with talent and the founders, and calibrate your reads against how people actually turn out.


You Might Be a Fit If

You are deeply fascinated by understanding human behaviour. You may have studied psychology, or not. You read well. You understand, far better than others, why someone does what they do. You understand and build systems. You hold a high bar. You are comfortable learning deeply technical things.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Mission

We are building the future of Australian-made AI because we believe it is critical to this country. Our product is Matilda, and while it is exceptional, our single biggest challenge right now is that not enough people know it exists.

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who can change that. Your mandate is to ensure people know about Matilda, understand what it can do, and see how it helps them get things done. We need a quiet professional who loves the craft, executes with exceptional taste, and is deeply motivated by the impact of their work. You will be the foundational force driving awareness and growth for Maincode and Matilda.

What You’ll Do

  • You will handle the actual work from start to finish, which means writing crisp copy, designing clean assets, setting up campaigns, and tracking the data to ensure we are actually growing.

  • You will manage our digital footprint across organic and paid channels, figuring out exactly how to get Matilda in front of the right audience.

  • A big part of this role is taking advanced AI capabilities and translating them into simple, stylish, and highly practical use cases that resonate with everyday users.

  • You will skip the slow planning cycles to test scrappy and contemporary ideas, launching quickly and adjusting based on what works.

Who You Are

  • You understand the stakes of building local AI infrastructure and are driven by the challenge of making it a recognised name.

  • You have a visceral reaction to bad design and clunky marketing jargon, and you naturally maintain a stylish and contemporary aesthetic across every touchpoint.

  • You are a humble professional who leaves your ego at the door and lets the quality of your output speak for itself.

  • You care about actual traction and obsess over how to convert raw awareness into active and engaged users.

The Maincoder Spirit

Maincoders are driven by a singular purpose that goes far beyond just another job. We believe this is our country's time to shine, requiring a level of selflessness, dedication, and restlessness from everyone involved. For us to succeed in making Australian-made AI world class, we need people who are tireless, passionate, and completely devoted to the cause. We will always choose someone with spirit, passion, and a true love for what we are building over someone who is highly credentialed but uninspired, because while we can teach skills, we can never teach heart.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Mission

We are building the future of Australian-made AI. We believe it is critical to this country. Our product is Matilda. Maincoders are driven by a singular purpose that goes far beyond just another job. We believe this is our country’s time to shine; requiring a level of selflessness, dedication, and restlessness from everyone involved. For us to succeed in making Australian-made AI world-class, we need people who are tireless, passionate, and completely devoted to the cause. We will always choose someone with spirit, passion, and a true love for what we are building over someone who is highly credentialed but uninspired, because while we can teach skills, we can never teach heart.

What we build

Matilda is a production system, available to use and integrate now. We run inference and model training on our own infrastructure.

 

What We Are Looking For

Software engineers. Across any layer of Maincode. Do your research and tell us how you can help.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Maincode

Maincode makes Matilda, an Australian-made AI stack we own end to end, from tin to token. We own and operate our own infrastructure here in Australia, we train and maintain our own frontier models, and we run multiple surfaces on top of them, including chat, coding and API. Everything we ship is built on capability we control ourselves. We are hiring someone who cares about that. You should be passionate about Australian-made technology, a builder first, and keen to execute at the frontier of data engineering and model training.

The role

A frontier model is only as capable as the data it learns from, and every model carries the worldview of the data it was trained on. We did this for Australia with Matilda’s voice. Now we are building the capability to do it for any country or market: training open weights models on custom datasets that reflect the cultural, regulatory, governance, and ideological requirements of the people who will use them.

You will be the hands on engineer who builds the system that makes those datasets. You will own the pipeline end to end, from web scale crawling of hard to reach, country specific sources through to filtering, deduplication, quality control, and the agent driven pipelines that turn raw material into training sets. We need someone who moves fast, writes code every day, and knows how to use AI agents to multiply what a small team can produce without letting quality slip.

What you will do

  • Build, run, and scale crawlers and scrapers for web scale collection, including specialized crawlers for high value, hard to reach sources such as legislation, regulator guidance, government publications, local media, and community forums.

  • Develop robust pipelines for extraction, filtering, cleaning, deduplication, and formatting to ensure the highest quality inputs for model training.

  • Build agentic pipelines where AI agents generate, annotate, critique, and verify data at scale, with the evaluation and spot checks needed to trust what they produce.

  • Turn a market’s requirements, from its laws and regulators to its cultural norms and governance expectations, into dataset specifications, data mixtures, and evaluations we can measure against.

  • Work directly with our core training team to iterate on data mixtures, evaluate data quality, and respond to model performance feedback.

  • Track provenance, licensing, privacy, and security for every dataset you ship.

What you will bring

  • A track record of building, scaling, and running large scale web crawling or scraping systems in production.

  • Strong engineering in Python and at least one of Go, Rust, or C++, with real experience in distributed data processing (Spark, Ray, Beam, or similar) and petabyte scale storage.

  • Hands on knowledge of the hard parts of crawling: JavaScript heavy sites, headless browsers, rate limiting, robots.txt, and access and licensing constraints.

  • Experience using LLMs and AI agents inside data pipelines for classification, extraction, synthetic data generation, or quality scoring, and a clear sense of where they fail.

  • A bias for shipping. You get a working pipeline running in days, then make it reliable.

  • Experience leading the technical direction of a project and bringing other engineers along with you.

Highly regarded

  • Direct experience building pre-training or post-training datasets for large language models, including SFT, preference, or reinforcement learning data.

  • Experience with multilingual, regional, or culturally specific data, or with evaluating models against local norms and regulation.

  • Experience fine-tuning or post-training open weights models.

  • Open source contributions to crawling, data processing, or dataset tooling.

  • A strong network within the Australian technology, academic, or media ecosystem to facilitate unique data partnerships.

Eligibility

  • Must have the right to work in Australia.

  • Willingness to undergo background checks as required.

Details

  • Location: Melbourne, VIC (or Hybrid/On-Site across Australia).

  • Type: Full time, permanent.

  • Remuneration: Negotiable based on experience, plus super and equity.

Who thrives here

Engineers who understand that high quality data is the true moat of any frontier model, and that it is also where a model’s values come from. If you care about Australian-made technology and you would rather spend your week shipping crawlers, tuning agent pipelines, and reading samples of your own data than sitting in steering committee meetings, you will do well here.

jobs.title: Account Director
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Maincode

Maincode makes Matilda, an Australian-made AI stack we own end to end, from tin to token. We own and operate our own infrastructure here in Australia, we train and maintain our own frontier models, and we run multiple surfaces on top of them, including chat, coding and API. Everything we ship is built on capability we control ourselves. We are hiring someone who cares about that. You should be passionate about Australian-made technology and AI, a relationship builder first, and keen to help Australian organisations adopt AI on their own terms.

The role

Matilda Enterprise gives organisations their own AI, trained on their own data, private to them, and kept secure and safe in Australia. Around it we are building a growing suite of products for governance, risk and compliance (GRC), model training, and cloud compute. Our customers trust us with sensitive data and important work, and that trust is built through long term relationships.

You will build and manage those relationships. You will work with CIOs, CISOs, and heads of data, risk, and compliance across enterprise and government. You will understand what they need and support them as they move from a first workload to wider use of Matilda across their organisation. This is a relationship role, and we are looking for someone who wants to stay with their customers for the long term.

Mainsail, our in-house sales platform built on Matilda, supports the team. It identifies buying signals, researches accounts and buying committees, drafts outreach, and prepares briefings before meetings. That leaves you more time to spend with customers.

This is a salaried role with no commission. We want you focused on what is right for each customer over the long term, rather than on closing deals by a particular date.

What you will do

  • Build and manage long term relationships with a portfolio of enterprise and public sector customers, from first meeting through renewal and growth.

  • Follow up on the opportunities Mainsail identifies, start the conversation, and develop them into lasting customer relationships.

  • Understand each customer’s business, data, and regulatory obligations well enough to recommend the right mix of Matilda Enterprise, GRC, model training, and compute.

  • Work with our engineers to scope deployments, whether in our own cloud in Australia, on premise, or in fully airgapped environments.

  • Run a disciplined process on every account, with clear next steps, prompt follow up, and an accurate pipeline.

  • Represent Maincode with customers and partners, and at industry events.

  • Share customer feedback with our product and engineering teams.

What you will bring

  • Experience selling platforms, such as SaaS, cloud, data, or security, into enterprise or government organisations.

  • A track record of long term customer relationships, including customers who renewed and grew with you over several years.

  • Discipline and consistency. You plan your week, follow up reliably, keep your pipeline current, and do what you said you would do.

  • A strong work ethic and plenty of drive. You chase things down, make the extra call, and put in the preparation.

  • A genuine interest in AI and in what we are building with Matilda. You use AI tools in your own work, you are comfortable working alongside AI agents, and you can explain clearly what private, custom AI means for an organisation.

  • Clear, practical, and direct communication, both written and spoken.

Highly regarded

  • Experience selling into Australian government, defence, financial services, health, or other regulated industries.

  • Experience selling data platforms, cloud infrastructure, GRC, or cybersecurity products.

  • An established network across Australian enterprise and the public sector.

  • Experience at an early stage company, building customer relationships from scratch.

Eligibility

  • Must have the right to work in Australia.

  • Willingness to undergo background checks as required.

Details

  • Location: Melbourne, VIC (or Hybrid/On-Site across Australia), with travel to customers as needed.

  • Type: Full time, permanent.

  • Remuneration: Competitive salary based on experience, plus super and equity. No commission.

Who thrives here

People who understand that enterprise AI is built on trust, and that trust takes time. If you care about Australian-made technology and you would rather spend your week with customers, following through on what you said you would do, than chasing quarter-end targets, you will do well here.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Human
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Maincode

Maincode exists to build technology independence for Australia: AI and infrastructure that nobody else can switch off or change. Matilda came first. It runs on the web, phones, desktop and terminal, and it is trained in MC-2, the AI factory we own and run in Melbourne. MC-3 and our own cloud come next.

When we started in late 2024, the ingredients for this were hard to find here. So from day one the plan was people: a small group who believed in the mission and would do whatever it took to build it here. That is still how we work. There are no ladders to climb and no playbook to follow. Everyone owns what they take on, from start to finish, and the work is about the mission, not anyone's career.

The role

You go wherever you are needed. That could mean sitting with a customer to help their team get real value from Matilda, introducing Matilda to an organisation that has never heard of it, working with a government agency or partner, or running an event. You will be on the ground, working it out as you go, with a highly technical team behind you whenever you need it.

You are

- Someone who gets things done.

- Comfortable with no spec, no manual and no one telling you what to do next.

- Good with people, and quick to learn whatever the problem in front of you needs.

- Here for the mission.

Nobody is going to hand Australia its technology independence. We are building it ourselves, and we need people who will go wherever the work is.
